source: Chief Architect X18 Tutorial Guide, Framing Tutorials, pages 331-348

steps.step: Framing Type defaults: I-Joist, Lumber (nominal sizes), LVL
steps.gap: Members are lumber, LVL, PSL, VSL or steel; no editable framing types or nominal-size setting. Row: FR-07

steps.step: Switch to the Framing, Floor Plan View
Automatic framing defaults: floor joists 16" OC, 1 1/2" wide
(Spacing per floor; Rim Joist construction is LVL)
steps.gap: One joist spacing for every floor; rim joists are lumber like the joists. Row: FR-34

steps.step: Framing Reference Marker at the outside corner of the framing, bottom left
steps.gap: Joist layout starts at each footprint's edge; no Framing Reference Marker to measure it from. Row: FR-33

steps.step: Copy the Framing, Floor layer set as 'Framing Set - Working' and turn on ceiling joists
Build Framing: floors and ceilings, rebuilt automatically
(Automatically Rebuild Framing)
steps.gap: Framing rebuilds when you choose Build Framing, not automatically when the model changes. Row: FR-35

steps.step: Joist Direction: a horizontal line in the basement; the joists turn to follow it
(rebuild)
Rotate the line 90 degrees: the joists follow
Delete it (joists go back), Undo; turn off automatic rebuild and delete it again
Bearing wall: the basement wall left of the stair becomes a foundation wall and a bearing wall
Build Framing once, Floors, Floor 1 only: the joists turn to bear on it
(Joists choose the shorter span between bearing walls and beams)
steps.gap: Joists run the short way across the whole floor and only splice over bearing walls; draw a Joist Direction line to turn them. Row: FR-33

steps.step: Post and beam defaults: beams 12" x 3 1/2" with joists; 3 1/2" posts with square footings
steps.gap: Posts and beams are 2x stock unless you type their size; no Manual Framing defaults or post-with-footing. Row: FR-34

steps.step: Post with Footing at the top of the stair wall; another at the top left of the Garage
Floor/Ceiling Beam from the post to the back wall, its top level with the joists
A second beam from the Garage post to the back wall, lowered 11 7/8" so the joists sit on it
(Rebuild: joists butt the first beam and lap over the second)
steps.gap: Joists don't stop at or bear on beams. Row: FR-33

steps.step: Move a ceiling joist; joists bump and push (Bumping/Pushing snap)
steps.gap: Joists can be moved but don't bump or push. Row: CAD-28

steps.step: Trim the ceiling joists to a selected joist (Trim Object, Sticky Mode)
steps.gap: Extend/Trim works on CAD lines and walls, not framing. Row: FR-36

steps.step: Framing rich text defaults: uppercase, centred, border with 6" margins
steps.gap: Text has a border but no margin, uppercase or per-character underline. Row: TXT-24

steps.step: Rich Text on Floor 0: ALL FLOOR JOISTS ARE U.N.O.: 2x12s SPF #2 OR BETTER @16" O.C.

steps.step: (border)
Copy it beside the deck joists and change it to deck joists, 2x10s

steps.step: Make a Copy as Chic Cottage-Floor Framing
steps.gap: No Make a Copy. Row: PRJ-45
